description:
crate-jmap-mail-types/README.md claims it covers 'every object type defined by RFC 8621'. True for the always-on items, but the crate also exports:

- `pub mod mdn` (Cargo feature `mdn`, RFC 9007: Message Disposition Notifications)
- `pub mod sieve` (Cargo feature `sieve`, RFC 9661: Sieve Script management)

Both have substantial public API: `SieveScript`, `SieveCapability`, `SieveAccountCapability`, `JMAP_SIEVE_SCRIPTS_URI`, `SieveScriptProperty`, plus all `mdn::*` types.

The README's 'References' section also fails to cite RFC 9007 or RFC 9661.

The Cargo.toml `[features]` table declares `mdn` and `sieve` but they're undocumented in README.

Fix: add 'Optional Features' section to README listing mdn and sieve, with a one-liner per RFC and the import path / type list.
title: P2: mail-types README doesn't mention mdn (RFC 9007) or sieve (RFC 9661) modules
